_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Folding@home egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Folding@home
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Folding@home lends your CPU to scientists simulating proteins to fight diseases. Runs the official client; link it to your Folding@home account with a token to start folding and manage it on the web.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Folding@home: downloads the Folding@home client (version 8) from
# foldingathome.org. Its database (client.db, with the work in progress)
# and logs are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
base=https://download.foldingathome.org/releases/public/fah-client

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) worker=debian-10-64bit ;;
    aarch64) worker=debian-stable-arm64 ;;
    *) echo "Folding@home has no client for this CPU ($(uname -m))."; exit 1 ;;
esac

version="${FAH_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    meta=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$base/meta.json") || { echo "foldingathome.org can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."; exit 1; }
    version=$(jq -r --arg w "$worker" '[.[] | select(.worker == $w and .mode == "release" and (.package | endswith(".tar.bz2")))][0].version | map(tostring) | join(".")' <<<"$meta")
    [ -n "$version" ] && [ "$version" != null ] || { echo "foldingathome.org lists no client for this CPU right now."; exit 1; }
fi
url="$base/$worker/release/fah-client_${version}-64bit-release.tar.bz2"
if [ "$(curl -sIL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$url")" != 200 ]; then
    echo "Folding@home client version $version doesn't exist for this CPU: see $base/$worker/release/."
    exit 1
fi

if [ -x fah-client ] && [ "$(cat .fah-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Folding@home client $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading the Folding@home client $version."
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o $work/fah.tar.bz2 "$url"
    mkdir -p $work/fah
    tar -xjf $work/fah.tar.bz2 -C $work/fah --strip-components=1
    install -m 0755 $work/fah/fah-client fah-client.new
    mv -f fah-client.new fah-client
    echo "$version" > .fah-version
fi
echo "Installed the Folding@home client $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Folding@home client version to install, such as 8.5.6, or latest.

variables.name: Account token
variables.description: The token from your account settings on foldingathome.org. The client stays paused until it's linked to an account.

variables.name: Machine name
variables.description: The name this machine has in your Folding@home account.

variables.name: Username
variables.description: The donor name your points are credited to.

variables.name: Team
variables.description: The number of the team your points go to; 0 for none.

variables.name: CPUs
variables.description: How many CPU threads to fold with. Keep it within the server's CPU limit.
